title: Unit Event — Time to Take Off! — Episode5 Music on the Backstreets

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD are just about ready to visit the US, where they'll attend the event Taiga and Ken are taking part in. An excited Toya is packing his things when he receives an unexpected message...

rows.Line: The next morning
New York Academy of Music - Cafeteria

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
Leeet's eat!
Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mmm!
This chicken sandwich is so good! I'm loving this barbeque sauce!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. This sausage sandwich is also really good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What did you two order again, Aoyagi, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I got some coffee, bacon and eggs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I got some cafe au lait and pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They said that it'd take a while to make them, but... Oh.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: “Here are your pancakes.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These are...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huge...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, this is pretty overwhelming...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sh-Shinonome, can I take a picture?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure. Actually, I'm gonna take one too.
<Wow! Those look amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've never seen such a huge stack of pancakes before!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len? When did you...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. I got curious, so I came to see what you guys were doing!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <New York's really is super big and amazing, huh!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, but I didn't think big meant...
No, this might actually count.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Len, what did I tell you about keeping it down?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. But I understand why he's so excited.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Hello!
We decided to follow Len after he said that he'd be coming over.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, how's your trip to the States been?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well...
Where to begin?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. So quite a lot has already happened.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But getting to stay in one of the dorms is super lucky! You wouldn't be able to under normal circumstances, right?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. It's ended up being a very valuable experience.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Plus, our rooms are nice and spacious.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The school in general seems very big, just looking around.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the New York Academy of Music doesn't just focus on classical music and jazz. There are many different departments on campus.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You can study pop, rock, world music, dance, musicals and much more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<World music?
Like music from different countries?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, Mr. Lloyd...
The professor we just mentioned was telling us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some students here major in Japanese instruments, like the koto and shamisen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, they really do cover a wide variety.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. You can name any field of music, and this school has produced some of its best players.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why nobody was surprised when my brother chose his major...

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “While attending a music school in Vienna, he had the chance to study here as an exchange student.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I had no idea that my dad had also attended.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I think that caught us all by surprise.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did your dad say anything before you left for this trip? He knew that you were going to New York, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I got his permission to go...
But he didn't say anything else.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He may not have seen any reason to mention it, since we didn't originally plan on stopping by here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm running on very little here...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But could he have spent his mornings in this very same cafeteria when he was a student?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm having a hard time imagining that...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How did he spend each of his days here?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, do you guys have any plans after this?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mr. Lloyd's gonna give us a tour of the campus!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But he has a couple of classes this morning, so we need to wait until he's done teaching.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were thinking that we could go somewhere in the meantime...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What should we do?
The manager did say that he'd drive us somewhere if we asked.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why don't we just wander around this area?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Around this area?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Remember what Mr. Lloyd said?
There's that street he said we should check out.

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “If you're interested, I recommend that you visit the backstreet behind campus.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Harumichi used to go there quite a lot when we were students.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go check it out...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate it... But are you all sure?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I think we're all really interested!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We didn't get a chance to do anything yesterday, with how hectic things got. Seems like a nice place to start.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...
New York Academy of Music - Backstreet

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wow...! What a beautiful street!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <All the signs are in English!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, someone's gonna notice if you guys don't keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you sure? It might actually be okay for us to talk normally.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It seems like such a lively place with all these different people doing street performances...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And tons of people are watching.
Look at that group over there! They're all clapping along!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but they seem like they're all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <All over the place? They sound pretty good to me...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I was talking about all the different genres.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm hearing classical, pop...
And some folk music coming from over there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see cellos, trumpets, guitars, accordions and... Oh, that person's even playing the harp.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's like a wave of different sounds with every step I take.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I had no idea that Dad spent so much time in this kind of place...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's a classical musician through and through, so I was under the impression that he had no interest in other types of music.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, that old man playing the guitar is really cool.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's like he's making his guitar talk.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, check it out!
Those kids are using snack tins as drums!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Wow, that looks like a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Fun, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The sights, and even the sounds, are different.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And yet, this street...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...it's a little similar to Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <To Vivid Street?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it! I thought something felt familiar about this place when we first arrived here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, they both give off the same sort of vibe!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I agree. There's music being played everywhere, and everyone here seems to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Music feels like a vital part of this neighborhood and its people. In that sense, they're very similar.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This place is nice.
